title: 第11章 击败齐盛第12章 春心荡漾的铁海棠
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
铁海棠看了一眼铁峰。
铁峰无奈摇头道：“既然你要想打，那就打吧，不过都是斩妖盟武者，比武切磋，点到为止。”
“要比武吗？齐盛大哥和那个毛头小子要打？”
“这还打个屁啊，齐盛大哥伸支手指就能按死他！”
“就是，齐盛大哥已经将玄级二品的武技修炼到了大成境界，他怎么可能是齐盛大哥的对手。”
武技修炼，分为了四个境界：入门，小成，大成，大圆满。
在齐盛这个二十出头的年纪，能将一本玄级武技，修炼到大成境界，那也算是很难得的。
“小子，等死吧！”齐盛恶狠狠的对林白说了一句。
斩妖盟的武者齐齐给他们二人让开了一个巨大的圆场，齐盛率先走入了圆场中。
铁海棠来到林白身边提醒到：“小心点，齐盛有一招武技‘天龙咆哮’已经修炼到大成境界了，如果不敌，就尽快认输。”
齐盛一声冷笑：“海棠，你不必提醒他，我要打败他，根本不用出天龙咆哮。”
“我明白了。”林白微微一笑，坦然的走入了场中。
“要开始了！”
“齐盛大哥，你是无敌的，打死他！”
“这狗屁小孩，毛还没有张齐，居然敢和齐盛大哥对战，简直不知死活。”
双方站定，斩妖盟的武者都支持齐盛，他们对齐盛的实力十分的肯定。
而林白初来匝道，看起来就一副弱不禁风的模样，在强壮的齐盛面前，看来就要输，自然得不到支持率。
“给你一个机会，拔剑吧，否则我出手了，你连拔剑的机会都没有。”齐盛注意到林白手中提着利剑，便蔑视的说道。
林白不屑一笑：“不用，让我拔剑，你就输了。”
“可恶的小子，你要为你这句话付出代价！”齐盛看出来被林白蔑视了，顿时勃然大怒。

脚步飞冲而来，气势全力展开，宛如一股狂风一般的席卷全场。
“一出手就是杀招吗？齐盛大哥是真的怒了！”有一个武者看出来齐盛的气势已经有些不对劲了。
铁海棠已经有一些担忧的看着林白，满脸愁容。
“嗯？”铁峰惊讶的看着自己的女儿，今天的铁海棠格外的安静，一点都不像是当初的那一朵霸王花了。
最让铁峰惊讶的是，铁海棠看向林白的目光，充满了担忧。
“呵呵。”
看了一眼铁海棠，又看了一眼林白，铁峰满脸红光的笑了，心中暗道：看来女儿的家室，又着落了~，哈哈哈。
“奔牛劲！”
哞！
一声低吼奔袭而来，齐盛冲击过来的时候，宛如化身一头蛮牛，誓要将面前的林白撞得粉碎不可！
风沙席卷，黄沙满天！
碰！林白躲都不躲的站在面前，任由齐盛冲击过来，当他到了面前的刹那，林白满脸狰狞的一拳打出！
噗嗤——
一拳落下，与奔牛劲撞击在一起，卷起万丈狂风。
“这怎么可能？”齐盛被林白一拳打飞出去，口吐鲜血，满脸惊讶的说道。
林白得意一笑：“你这个奔牛劲，太烂了！还有更强的武技吗？如果没有的话，我拔剑你就没机会施展了！”
“小子，你别得意！”
“看我的，镇山龙拳！”
齐盛怒吼一声，赤黄色的真气从地而起，凝聚在他的双拳之上！
喝！齐盛爆喝一声，双拳奔袭而来。

“这招武技到是不错，但是你还有修炼到家就敢拿出来丢人现眼！”林白双目一狭，杀意毕露。
碰！
一拳打出，齐盛再次被林白打飞出去，落在十米之外，浑身狼狈不堪。
“啊！”
content_en:
Tie Haitang glanced at Tie Feng.
Tiefeng shook his head helplessly and said: "Since you want to fight, then go ahead. However, they are all warriors of the Demon Slayer Alliance. They compete with each other until the point is reached."
"Are you going to compete in martial arts? Brother Qi Sheng and that young boy want to fight?"
"This is a slap in the face, Brother Qi Sheng can just stretch out his fingers and crush him to death!"
"That's right, Brother Qi Shengsheng has cultivated his second-grade Xuan-level martial arts to the level of Dacheng. How can he be Brother Qi Shengsheng's opponent?"
Martial arts training is divided into four realms: Beginner, Small Success, Dacheng, and Dzogchen.
At the age of Qi Sheng, who is in his early twenties, it is rare to be able to practice a Xuan-level martial arts to the level of Dacheng.
"Boy, wait to die!" Qi Sheng said to Lin Bai fiercely.
The warriors of the Demon-Slaying Alliance all made way for the two of them to create a huge circle, and Qi Sheng took the lead in walking into the circle.
Tie Haitang came to Lin Bai and reminded him: "Be careful, Qi Sheng has a martial art called 'Tianlong Roar' that he has already mastered to a great level. If you lose, give up as soon as possible."
Qi Sheng sneered: "Haitang, you don't need to remind him. If I want to defeat him, I don't even need to use the Dragon Roar."
"I understand." Lin Bai smiled slightly and walked into the field calmly.
"It's about to begin!"
"Brother Qi Sheng, you are invincible, beat him to death!"
"This bullshit kid, even before Mao Qi, dares to fight against Brother Qi Sheng, he doesn't know how to live or die."
Both sides stood firm, and the warriors of the Demon Slayer Alliance all supported Qi Sheng. They were very sure of Qi Sheng's strength.
When Lin Bai came to the ramp for the first time, he looked very weak. In front of the strong Qi Sheng, he looked like he was about to lose, so he naturally lost support.
"Give you a chance to draw your sword, otherwise I will take action and you won't even have a chance to draw your sword." Qi Sheng noticed Lin Bai holding a sharp sword in his hand and said with contempt.
Lin Bai smiled disdainfully: "No, let me draw my sword, and you will lose."
"Damn boy, you have to pay the price for your words!" Qi Sheng saw that he was despised by Lin Bai and suddenly became furious.
The footsteps rushed forward, and the momentum was fully unfolded, sweeping the entire place like a violent wind.
"Is it a killing move? Brother Qi Sheng is really angry!" A warrior saw that something was wrong with Qi Sheng's aura.
Tie Haitang was already looking at Lin Bai with some worry, with a sad look on his face.
"Huh?" Tie Feng looked at his daughter in surprise. Tie Haitang was particularly quiet today, not at all like the overlord flower back then.
What surprised Tie Feng the most was that Tie Haitang's eyes looked at Lin Bai, full of worry.
"Haha."
After looking at Tie Haitang and then at Lin Bai, Tie Feng smiled with a red face and thought to himself: It seems that his daughter's family is settled again~, hahaha.
"Running Bull Racing!"
Moo!
A low roar came rushing towards him, and when Qi Sheng charged towards him, he was like turning into a wild bull, vowing to smash Lin Bai in front of him to pieces!
The wind and sand swept across, and the sky was filled with yellow sand!
bump! Lin Bai stood in front of him without even trying to hide, letting Qi Sheng attack him. The moment he arrived in front of him, Lin Bai punched out with a ferocious look on his face!
Pfft——
A punch fell, colliding with the running bull force, and whipped up a strong wind.
"How is this possible?" Qi Sheng was punched by Lin Bai and flew away. He vomited blood and said with surprise on his face.
Lin Bai smiled proudly: "Your bull-running skills are so bad! Are there any stronger martial arts skills? If not, you won't have a chance to use them when I draw my sword!"
"Boy, don't be proud!"
"Look at me, the Mountain-Suppressing Dragon Fist!"
Qi Sheng roared angrily, and red-yellow energy rose from the ground and condensed on his fists!
drink! Qi Sheng let out a loud roar and rushed towards him with both fists.
"This martial arts technique is indeed pretty good, but you dare to use it to embarrass yourself even though you have not yet mastered it!" Lin Bai narrowed his eyes, revealing his murderous intent.
bump!
With one punch, Qi Sheng was knocked out by Lin Bai again and landed ten meters away, in a miserable state.
